statements.impact_statement: The server binary and the ferroehr image of FerroEHR 5.5.0 and every earlier release that locks zip 9.0.4 carry the crate, which the server links for the administrator's dump and load archive (app/ferroehr/src/service/admin/dump_load.rs: zip::ZipWriter to write it, zip::ZipArchive to read it). Through 9.0.4, ZipArchive takes a file's name from the central directory while ZipStreamReader takes it from the local file header, so one crafted archive can name two different files. FerroEHR's own code calls no streaming reader, but the vulnerable crate ships in these releases, so the statement does not argue the finding away. The viewer image does not link the crate. FerroEHR 5.6.0 locks zip 9.1.3 and its workspace requires 9.0.5 or later, so 5.6.0 and later releases carry no affected version.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade to FerroEHR 5.6.0 or later, whose server binary and ferroehr image carry zip 9.1.3; 5.6.0 is the first release that fixes the finding, and no release before it receives the fix. Until the upgrade, load through POST /admin/load only archives that this FerroEHR wrote with POST /admin/dump and that no one else could alter.
